name: Brenda Lee Anderson
office: Chicago Board of Education Member, Subdistrict 6A

items.text: Brenda Lee Anderson is an education policy researcher and equity consultant with a Ph.D. in education. She previously taught at Northwestern University. She is co-editing a book on education policy.

sentences.text: Brenda Lee Anderson is an education policy researcher and equity consultant with a Ph.D. in education.
She previously taught at Northwestern University.
She is co-editing a book on education policy.

items.text: Her top priority is fixing the Chicago Public Schools budget by pursuing untapped federal funding and more state money. She says she would base decisions on evidence-backed policies. Her platform includes expanding mental health support and building a teacher pipeline program to diversify the workforce. She opposes school closures unless the community supports them.
